title: Policy Optimization and Statistical Inference for Online Contextual Matrix Games
abstract: arXiv:2608.17173v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online decision making often requires navigating a landscape shaped by both dynamic contexts and strategic interactions. In competitive pricing, for example, hotels must account for both dynamic contextual factors and rivals' strategic responses. Existing approaches address only part of this challenge: contextual bandits optimize single-agent decisions using observable features but ignore multi-player interactions, while online matrix games capture strategic behavior through Nash equilibrium but assume fixed payoffs, ignoring contextual information. How should agents act then when strategic payoffs evolve with contextual signals? We introduce \emph{online contextual matrix games} to integrate contextual information into multi-player online games. translated_title: 在线上下文矩阵博弈的策略优化与统计推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17173v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在线决策通常需要在动态情境和战略互动的双重影响下进行导航。例如，在竞争性定价中，酒店必须同时考虑动态情境因素和竞争对手的战略响应。现有方法仅部分解决了这一挑战：上下文赌博机通过可观察特征优化单代理决策，但忽略了多玩家互动；而在线矩阵博弈通过纳什均衡捕捉战略行为，但假设支付固定，忽略了上下文信息。那么，当战略支付随情境信号演变时，代理应如何行动？我们引入了“在线上下文矩阵博弈”来将情境信息整合到多玩家在线博弈中。我们进一步提出了“OnGameLearn”，一种在线学习算法，能够有效平衡玩家行动和情境之间的探索与利用。该方法带有统计保证。
tldr: 本文提出了在线上下文矩阵博弈框架和OnGameLearn算法，首次将情境信息与多玩家战略互动结合，实现高效探索与利用平衡，并提供统计推断保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces online contextual matrix games and the OnGameLearn algorithm, which integrates contextual information with multi-player strategic interactions for efficient exploration-exploitation balance with statistical inference guarantees.
